target_customer: Primary care clinics and community health centers whose back offices manage specialist referrals
problem: Referral work such as prior authorizations, record sending and patient follow up is manual and understaffed, so many specialist referrals are never completed.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to clinics and health centers (pricing not public)
product_category: AI agents for healthcare referral management

founders.name: Joshua Chang
education: Stanford University, BS and MS Computer Science

competitors.name: Saffron Health
competitors.what: AI agents that automate the specialist referral process for primary care groups

competitors.name: AristaMD
competitors.what: Referral management and eConsult platform for primary care providers

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs EMR integration, payer portal automation, eFax and voice agents, and HIPAA/SOC compliance, which is standard but broad engineering for a four person team.

defensibility.rationale: Per clinic submission rules learned and EMR integrations give some lock in, but similar referral and prior authorization agents were launching in 2025.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several vendors launched referral or prior authorization automation in 2025; no acquisition of Locata found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: The company cites over 100 million specialist referrals per year in the US with only about half completed, and understaffed primary care back offices. This is the company's own claim.

identity.logo: Wordmark logo; a design studio portfolio page claims it created the brand and logo (unverified attribution)
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and practical, tagline Automate Your Referral Loop

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand evidence beyond a tagline and a design studio page; no press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Locata is an early stage company, active as of 2026-11. It signed community health center customers soon after launch and shows five named customer logos on its site. Funding is not verified beyond aggregator claims, so no outcome can be judged yet; the main risk is a crowded set of referral and prior authorization automation vendors.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, FundedIQ, Employbl) report a $500K pre-seed around 2025-09, one lists a January 2025 seed; no primary source or Form D found, so unverified and not recorded as a round. An outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Founder education and employers come from the YC page. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed (2025-09) is recorded from VCBacked, with Employbl (Diffbot data) also reporting 500K; both are aggregators. Standout.work labels it seed.
